name: port-nosignal
summary: Declare the DP and HDMI input ports "no signal" after 200 x 20 ms = 4.0 s instead of 8-10 s (faster automatic input scan and "No signal"); USB-C keeps the vendor 8 s

edits.asm: sub_260E0E ori r5,r0,0x1f4 -> ori r5,r0,0xc8 (port +0x1A no-signal threshold, type bit3/4/0x400, normal case)
stub (linker padding 0x203970): if port r3 == 1 (DP) r5 = 200; j sub_23E5C5
sub_260E0E type-0x20 branch: jal sub_23E5C5 -> jal stub

notes: Port +0x1A thresholds set by sub_260E0E (vendor: 400 passes for type 0x20 = ports 0 USB-C and 1 DP, 500 for types bit3/4/0x400 = ports 2-5, 200 in the flag case). v2: ports 2-5 -> 200; port 1 (DP) -> 200 through a stub on the type-0x20 sub_23E5C5 call; port 0 (USB-C) unchanged (a dock delivers its stream later). LG 28MQ780 uses 100. Accept thresholds (+0x18, see port-accept) unchanged. Generated by tools/patches_src_port_nosignal.py (NOSIG=n, 50-255).
